item.title: Navtarang and Radio Sargam teams gear up for the Diwali Dhamaka Show this Saturday
item.description: People will have the chance to enjoy live entertainment, win prizes and meet their favourite radio personalities when the Navtarang Sargam Diwali Dhamaka Show is held at Rup's Complex in Nakasi this Saturday. Navtarang personality Prashnil Prasad says Diwali is an auspicious festival that celebrates the return of Lord Ram from 14 years of exile.
item.content:encoded:
People will have the chance to enjoy live entertainment, win prizes and meet their favourite radio personalities when the Navtarang Sargam Diwali Dhamaka Show is held at Rup's Complex in Nakasi this Saturday.

Navtarang personality Prashnil Prasad says Diwali is an auspicious festival that celebrates the return of Lord Ram from 14 years of exile.

Prasad says the team is preparing performances on Bollywood songs, popular Diwali numbers and entertainment planned for the audience.

He says the team is preparing special performances to bring the spirit of Diwali to the stage, with final preparations now underway.

Prasad says people will also have the opportunity to interact with their favourite radio personalities, take photographs with them and win prizes, thanks to Glamada.

The event will also showcase local talent.

He is encouraging families to attend in numbers and enjoy the celebrations. The Navtarang Sargam Diwali Dhamaka Show will be held this Saturday from 5pm at Rup's Complex in Nakasi.
